summary: Add an alphabetical row for your platform to the settings_by_platform table, keeping | and + aligned and ticking only supported connection types.
questions: How do I add my platform to the network settings table?

answer_card.title: Update the platform options table
answer_card.answer_md:
Add a row in alphabetical order:
```text
| My OS             | ``myos``                | ✓           | ✓       |         | ✓        |
```
Keep `|` aligned with `+`, and check only the connection types your modules provide.
